name: AVA (AirAsia Virtual Allstar)
reason: Capital A announced on 8 Feb 2023 that it was retiring AVA (launched 2019) and replacing it with a new chatbot called Ask Bo, named after AirAsia Aviation Group CEO Bo Lingam (soyacincau, marketing-interactive, Travel Weekly).

name: Cascade
reason: windsurf.com/cascade now 308-redirects to devin.ai/desktop; Windsurf was renamed Devin Desktop in June 2026 and Cascade was retired on 1 July 2026, with Devin Local as the default agent (Devin is already in the catalog).

name: Aria
reason: Opera's blog (29 Oct 2025) says the new Opera One browser AI, built on the Neon Chat Agent, is 'replacing our first generation free browser AI named Aria'.

name: Bullseye Gift Finder
reason: Target's 12 Nov 2025 press release calls the current tool the conversational AI-powered 'Target Gift Finder'; the 'Bullseye Gift Finder' name does not appear.

name: The Girl
reason: 'The Girl' was a placeholder: in August 2025 a public vote of about 14,000 people named the AI Emirati character Latifa, with 43% of votes (Khaleej Times, 18 Aug 2025).

name: Amazon Q
reason: AWS is retiring the Amazon Q brand: Q Developer IDE/CLI was announced end-of-life on 30 Apr 2026 (new signups blocked 15 May 2026, migrating to Kiro, already listed), and Q Business closed to new customers in mid-2026 in favor of Amazon Quick Suite (AWS 'Upgrade to Kiro' docs; Atlan; Factual Minds).

name: Alice (Alisa)
reason: In late 2025 Yandex rebranded its assistant and model family from Alice/YandexGPT to 'Alice AI' (Alisa AI), now in Search, the Alice app and alice.yandex.ru (Postium, Sostav 25 Nov 2025, Habr).

name: Hey CommBank
reason: 'Hey CommBank' was the September 2024 name for CBA's generative AI chatbot then being tested with employees; CBA's May 2026 newsroom launched the same kind of in-app conversational AI as 'CommBank Companion', and no current use of 'Hey CommBank' turns up (the rename is inferred, not stated by CBA).

name: Kanana
reason: Reports say Kakao is shutting the standalone Kanana app around 15 Oct 2026 and moving Kanana into KakaoTalk's Friends tab (FN News, 8 Sep 2026), so the name stays live but the 'standalone messenger' description and source are out of date.
newUse: AI companion app with two AI mates, Nana (personal assistant) and Kana (group-chat helper), moving into KakaoTalk's Friends tab in October 2026.

name: ABIE
reason: The only sources are a 2018 launch and aggregator listicles (Emerj, Heretto); searches found nothing after 2018 showing ABIE is still on Allstate.com, so it is probably retired.

name: Charlie
reason: The current source is the 2019 launch story; Ada's case study describes Charlie as Cebu Pacific's current generative AI agent pulling from its knowledge base.

name: Amelia
reason: The current source is the 2020 launch story; April 2025 coverage says Amelia now also replaces Wizz Air's call centre, phoning passengers during disruptions, so it is still live.
